name: The Dawnless Chapel
intro: The embers flare and the Mountain Pass is gone. You stand in a chapel three hundred years ago, on the morning the sun did not rise — and the Eclipse is already inside.

rooms.name: The Dawnless Chapel - The Ruined Narthex
rooms.description: The chapel's entrance hall lies in ruin, its holy water fonts cracked and dry. North, the great doors into the nave are barred from within.

rooms.name: The Dawnless Chapel - The Nave of Night
rooms.description: Rows of overturned pews fill a nave lit only by the dark. Every window shows the same black sun. North, a rail closes off the altar.

rooms.name: The Dawnless Chapel - The Altar of the Eclipse
rooms.description: The altar has been turned to face the wrong way. Above it, where the order's dawn window should be, there is only a disc of perfect black.

waves.text: Dawnless zealots rise from the rubble, blades drawn!
The shadows in the nave stand up and take shape!
Eclipse shades pour down from the dark windows!

gates.text: The bar falls from the nave doors.
The altar rail swings open. Something rises behind it.

boss.text: Morvane the Eclipsed rises before the altar, a black sun burning in his chest. 'The dawn is a lie your order tells its children,' he says. 'Let me show you the truth.'
